item.title: EU's Ursula von der Leyen says she wants Canada to become an associate member
item.description: European Commission President Ursula von der Leyen on Wednesday proposed making Canada the European Union's first associate member, a striking overture as U.S. President Donald Trump's tariffs drive Ottawa closer to Europe.
item.content:encoded:
European Commission President Ursula von der Leyen on Wednesday proposed making Canada the European Union's first associate member, a striking overture as U.S. President Donald Trump's tariffs drive Ottawa closer to Europe.

(Image credit: Pascal Bastien)
item.dc:creator: The Associated Press

item.title: Senators question Trump's picks for top health positions, including surgeon general
item.description: On Wednesday, the Senate committee on health holds a confirmation hearing for three top health officials, including surgeon general. Dr. Nicole Saphier is President Trump's third attempt to nominate a surgeon general.
item.content:encoded:

item.title: Kosovo's ex-President Thaci convicted of war crimes, sentenced to 25 years in prison
item.description: A European Union-backed court convicted former Kosovo President Hashim Thaci of war crimes committed during his country's war for independence from Serbia and sentenced him to 25 years in prison.
item.content:encoded:
A European Union-backed court convicted former Kosovo President Hashim Thaci of war crimes committed during his country's war for independence from Serbia and sentenced him to 25 years in prison.

(Image credit: Koen van Weel)

item.title: Saudi Arabia calls an attempted Mecca attack a 'red line' as Houthis deny they did it
item.description: Saudi Arabia accused Yemen's Iran-backed Houthi rebels overnight of trying to attack Islam's holiest city, prompting condemnation from countries in the region but no sign of military support.

item.title: A Kansas girl ran off to join the circus and changed the tattoo world
item.description: One of the country's first known female tattoo artists was born on a Kansas farm. Maud Stevens Wagner ran off to join the circus and later became a tattoo legend.

item.title: The 500 colleges where former students aren't repaying their loans, and why
item.description: Federal data shows many borrowers who aren't paying their loans went to private, for-profit colleges — schools that often market to low-income students and rely on federal financial aid for revenue.

item.title: As campaign season gears up, AI-generated ads are everywhere
item.description: Data suggests many candidates are embracing AI this year to boost their image and portray their opponents unfavorably. But whether it will turn out voters remains unclear.

item.title: The Fed is expected to raise interest rates for the first time in 3 years
item.description: The Fed is widely expected to raise its benchmark interest rate to combat stubborn inflation. That could make it more expensive to borrow money to buy a car or carry a balance on a credit card.
